page_title: ANG 1-3 REI | Angers v Reims 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) commits a foul and Eric Wattellier immediately signals a free kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Farid El Melali (Angers) works the corner short.

89' Farid El Melali (Angers) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.

87' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
86' Amine Salama (Reims) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Yahia Fofana. Reims win a corner.
84' 1 - 3 Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the right post.
83' That will be all from Junya Ito who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed Daramy (Reims).

81' Ibrahima Niane (Angers) thinks he has scored after reacting fastest to a lofted ball into the box, but Yehvann Diouf pulls a rabbit out of the hat and makes a stunning save to thwart him for close range.
80' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Haris Belkebla is replaced by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Himad Abdelli trots off the pitch and is replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
79' 0 - 3 Goal! Yahia Fofana makes a huge mistake and Marshall Munetsi (Reims) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 0:3.
78' The goalkeeper dives to deny Farid El Melali (Angers), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.

77' Teddy Teuma (Reims) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Yahia Fofana pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.
76' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Yaya-Kader Fofana will be replaced by Teddy Teuma (Reims).
75' That's the end of the game for Jean-Eudes Aholou, who is replaced by Ibrahima Niane (Angers).
73' A pass by Junya Ito (Reims) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
70' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the right post as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
69' Substitution. Buta makes way for Nhoa Sangui (Reims).
69' Here is a change. Oumar Diakite is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Amine Salama (Reims).
69' Here's the change. Keito Nakamura leaves the pitch and Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) comes on as a substitute.
67' Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
67' The resulting set piece from Reims is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Reims.
66' Oumar Diakite (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Reims earn a corner.
64' Florent Hanin (Angers) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off the line to clear the ball away.
62' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) replacing Carlens Arcus.
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Farid El Melali (Angers) coming on for Jim Allevinah.
62' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.

59' Keito Nakamura (Reims) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
58' Jim Allevinah (Angers) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
55' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Yahia Fofana and he makes a comfortable save.
54' Angers take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' A lofted pass finds Buta (Reims) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the right post.
52' One of the players from Angers times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Eric Wattellier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
51' Reims will take a free kick near the side line.
50' A player from Angers commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
48' The referee is firm and issues Oumar Diakite (Reims) a deserved yellow card.

48' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.

47' Keito Nakamura (Reims) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The free kick from close range, taken by Angers, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' Angers get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
44' Buta (Reims) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
43' Keito Nakamura (Reims) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.

42' Oumar Diakite (Reims) comes close to scoring! He meets a lovely lofted pass from Keito Nakamura, but sends his close-range header way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
41' Neat passing move from Reims in order to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
40' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
39' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) picks up an injury.
39' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
37' Jim Allevinah (Angers) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
36' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Reims players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
32' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
29' A player from Angers commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
25' 0 - 2 Goal! Junya Ito (Reims) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
24' Jim Allevinah (Angers) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yehvann Diouf intercepts the ball.
22' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Reims will take a throw-in.
19' Florent Hanin (Angers) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

15' CHANCE! Marshall Munetsi (Reims) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
14' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.

13' Golden chance! Junya Ito (Reims) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
12' Angers have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Angers will have a corner.

9' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Keito Nakamura (Reims) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Cedric Kipre. The score is now 0:1.
8' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Yahia Fofana was alert and made a comfortable save.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Reims, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Junya Ito (Reims) will take the free kick.
6' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Eric Wattellier blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Reims.
4' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is able to continue to play.
3' Looks like Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Angers will kick the game off.
Eric Wattellier will supervise the game today.
